name: ModelVariant786_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant786_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a volley of bolts launches one every third frame from a model point and drifts across the field with a fading ribbon trail; bolts that reach their limit burst into a glow with a fan of rays and a ring of rising animated sprites while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 from the first burst until the last bolt bursts, 1 once when the last bolt bursts, 2 after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-803 and 900 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
